description: Read the authoritative outcome of a receipt batch: a submit_receipt batch by its exact ID (submissionId), or the latest upload (including in-app) via withinSeconds. Poll at the returned interval/time allowance (small batch at least 5 minutes; larger longer). Pending is normal: never blindly resubmit. found:false = pending/no terminal verdict; found:true = terminal. Returns added/duplicate/skipped/held_for_review/errored per-file outcomes, exact counts and up to 10 summaries. Held files (missing details or a possible duplicate) were not added; relay only their message's next step (use the returned Review files link), do not invent a missing card or direct held uploads to Gmail Action Needed. Show spreadsheetUrl/reviewExpensesUrl for rows actually added, not for held files. Unknown outcomes stay unknown. Gmail scans use get_scan_status. Read-only.

submissionId.description: Exact submissionId returned by submit_receipt. Strongly preferred because it binds the result to this upload instead of an earlier receipt.

withinSeconds.description: Lookback seconds for the latest upload when there is no submissionId.

name: get_last_receipt_result

outputSchema.description: found:false means processing is still pending; found:true is a terminal result.

heldForReview.description: Files held for review and not added. Present only when at least one.

receipts.description: Processed receipt summaries. Held files are not listed here; see data.outcomes.

state.description: Present on pending polls for a specific submission.

verdict.description: Terminal only. held_for_review: every file was held, none added; mixed also covers batches with held files.
